answer.text: Advising on capital-market issuances (IPO/FPO), underwriting, and compliance

explanation.text: The Logic: Merchant bankers lead-manage issuances and related compliance. The Trap: Brokerage/derivatives/insurance are separate. Cross-Exam Context: Same in IX. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Monitor DRHP filings from reputable MBs for upcoming primary-market opportunities.
